WO-0505.source: real record approved on 5 May 2026 (transcribed from Figure 8)
WO-0505.text:
Incident Report:
  Timestamp : 2026-05-05 15:00:00
  Vibration : 3.54 mm/s
  ISO Zone : Zone C (Unsatisfactory)
  IDK Status : Anomaly
Root Cause Analysis:
  The current vibration level of 3.54 mm/s places the machine in ISO 10816 Zone C, indicating unsatisfactory conditions. The anomaly status suggests a deviation from normal operational parameters, potentially due to mechanical imbalance or misalignment.
Recommended Actions:
  1. Inspect the conveyor for any signs of mechanical imbalance or misalignment.
  2. Check for any loose or worn components that may contribute to increased vibration.
  3. Verify the alignment of the conveyor belt and adjust if necessary.
  4. Conduct a thorough inspection of the motor and bearings for wear or damage.
Operator comment: Operating condition changing to 40 KG load during this period.
Priority: High

WO-B.text:
Incident Report:
  Timestamp : 2026-02-18 09:30:00
  Vibration : 3.10 mm/s
  ISO Zone : Zone C
Symptom: jerky running of the conveyor chain, noticed by the operator during the morning shift.
Root Cause Analysis: conveyor chain too loose; measured sag above the value in the manual.
Actions taken: 1. Switched off electricity and locked out. 2. Tensioned the conveyor chain to the manual value. 3. Test run without products: running smooth.
Result: jerky running stopped.
Priority: Medium

WO-A.text:
Incident Report:
  Timestamp : 2026-03-11 13:30:00
  Vibration : 2.90 mm/s
  ISO Zone : Zone C
Symptom: abnormal wear on plastic top plates near the drive end.
Root Cause Analysis: conveyor loaded above the recommended loading during a trial batch.
Actions taken: 1. Reduced the load to the recommended loading. 2. Replaced six worn top plates. 3. Checked free running of the chain.
Result: no further wear at the next weekly check.
Priority: Low

WO-C.text:
Routine maintenance:
  Date : 2026-01-20
Task: cleaned the conveyor chain and slide rail and lubricated them with silicone-based lubricant, as in the manual.
Interval agreed with the supervisor: monthly.
Result: completed, no defects found.
Priority: Low

WO-D.text:
Incident Report:
  Timestamp : 2026-04-08 10:15:00
  Vibration : 3.30 mm/s
  ISO Zone : Zone C
Symptom: jerky running of the conveyor chain.
Root Cause Analysis: chain tension was checked and found within the manual value, so tension was not the cause. The drive sprocket teeth were worn.
Actions taken: 1. Replaced the drive sprocket. 2. Test run: running smooth.
Priority: Medium
